items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: We did that all the time. And actually Mike Melvoin wrote all those charts for that particular album.

ctx.x: I’m going to share another thing from — here’s what Tom Scott had to say about that question. And he said that he did some sessions with a producer that did The Partridge Family and David Cassidy records. And he said, “The horn section at that time was me, Chuck Findley, Ollie Mitchell, Slyde Hyde and Lou McCurry. So even if the tune was kind of dumb or mundane it didn’t matter. We were there to play the best damn horn section you’ve ever heard in your life. We took our part very seriously. We didn’t know how far…

We did that all the time. And actually Mike Melvoin wrote all those charts for that particular album. But we always, one thing I always did, always did after a session, whether it was good or bad I mean the track. I’m not talking about what we did but I’m just, like Tom said, we would make the record. We were like the icing on the cake you know. You know you build a house but you need to decorate it. We decorated it. We decorated all kinds of things you know and make it sellable, this house. You know? Because it…
What kind of thing, this could be a pro or a con, but would you go home and bother to bring up what your day was like? What kind of sessions?
